candidates.name: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo
verified_facts: Gets the last run-time information for a scheduled task
A task can be selected by TaskName or supplied as an input object
semantic_limits: Task runtime metadata does not prove the process owner, receipt validity, or successful Git push

candidates.name: Get-WinEvent
verified_facts: Gets events from Windows event logs and ETW log files
Supports provider, log, XPath, XML, and hashtable filtering
semantic_limits: Event logs can be incomplete, inaccessible, or unrelated; matching task identity and timestamps remain required

candidates.name: Get-FileHash
verified_facts: Computes a file hash using a specified algorithm
LiteralPath can identify the exact file without wildcard expansion
semantic_limits: A hash proves content equality only against a trusted expected value; it does not prove authorship or freshness

candidates.name: ConvertFrom-Json
verified_facts: Converts a JSON-formatted string into a PowerShell object or hash table
Get-Content -Raw can supply a complete JSON file as one string
semantic_limits: Successful parsing does not validate required fields, types, uniqueness, identity, or semantic correctness

candidates.name: Test-Path
verified_facts: Determines whether path elements exist
LiteralPath uses the supplied path exactly and PathType can distinguish leaf from container
semantic_limits: Path existence alone does not prove valid JSON, correct task identity, content integrity, or freshness

candidates.name: Get-NetTCPConnection
verified_facts: Gets current TCP connections
Exposes local and remote endpoints, state, creation time, and owning process
semantic_limits: A current connection does not prove the application request, TLS validation, Git authentication, or push succeeded

candidates.name: Get-NetIPConfiguration
verified_facts: Gets IP network configuration including usable interfaces, IP addresses, and DNS servers
Without parameters it targets connected non-virtual interfaces
semantic_limits: Interface configuration is supporting host evidence and does not prove end-to-end repository access

candidates.name: Get-DnsClientServerAddress
verified_facts: Gets DNS server IP addresses associated with computer interfaces
Can select interfaces by index, alias, or address family
semantic_limits: Configured DNS servers do not prove successful name resolution or correctness of returned records

candidates.name: Get-TimeZone
verified_facts: Gets the current Windows time zone or available time zones
Returns time-zone identity and offset context
semantic_limits: Time-zone identity does not prove the system clock is synchronized or receipt timestamps are authentic

candidates.name: Get-Counter
verified_facts: Gets Windows performance counter data from local or remote computers
SampleInterval and MaxSamples bound sampling duration and count
semantic_limits: Localized counter names and permissions can affect availability; samples do not prove runner correctness
